diary.belowbedrock.1.1:
Day 1.

I broke the bedrock with that wrong pickaxe. I fell for a very long time.

I woke up here. It's my world. But my house isn't here.
diary.belowbedrock.1.2:
Day 2.

No animals. No monsters. No sound.

There is no sun, and yet it is always day. The colours look... tired.
diary.belowbedrock.1.3:
Day 3.

I found a sign. It said what I thought yesterday, without telling anyone.
diary.belowbedrock.1.4:
Day 4.

There was someone on the hill. Tall. White. Still.

I blinked and he was gone.
diary.belowbedrock.2.1:
Day 6.

He leaves me things. Maps. He is drawn on them.

One of them had me on it, from behind.
diary.belowbedrock.2.2:
Day 7.

If you look at him, he stops.
If you don't, he comes closer.

Don't run. Don't turn around too fast.
diary.belowbedrock.2.3:
Day 9.

Torches go out by themselves. Doors open by themselves.

Yesterday I heard footsteps. Mine. I was standing still.
diary.belowbedrock.2.4:
Day 11.

You can't sleep here. The beds say there are monsters nearby.

There are no monsters. There is only him.
diary.belowbedrock.3.1:
Day ?

The only way out is down.

Dig to the bedrock with the pickaxe. Jump. Fall.

Don't look up while you fall.
